mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.enabled = 1 AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission != ''
SELECT menu_id FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.enabled = 1 AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission != ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, component, permission, icon, sort_order, enabled, is_frame) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{menuType}, #{path}, #{component}, #{permission}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{enabled}, #{isFrame})
